text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit stopping at all times on the northwest corner of Grant Street and Kintyre Avenue. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and improve vehicle operations by maintaining a clear passage for turning vehicles.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Kintyre Avenue from Grant Street to a point 15 metres further west. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Grant Street from Kintyre Avenue to the north terminus of Grant Street.
